description:
RimSort is an open source mod manager for the video game RimWorld. There is support for Linux, Mac, and Windows, built from the ground up to be a reliable, community-managed alternative to RimPy Mod Manager.


<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v1.15.0 -->

## What's Changed

• feat：advance the runner progress bar across phases by @LionelColaso in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2497
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
• fix：guard database_expiry parsing against non-numeric input by @LionelColaso in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2500
